grammar.title: Articles: A, An and The
grammar.explanation:
Use **a** or **an** with one thing when it is not specific, or when you mention it for the first time. Say **a frying pan** and **a dentist**.

Use **an** before a vowel **sound**, not a vowel letter. Say **an apple** and **an hour**.

Use **the** when the listener knows which thing you mean. Say **the sun** and **the door**.

Use **the** when you talk about something again. First **a car**, then **the car**.

Use no article with plural nouns in general and with uncountable nouns in general. Say **I like dogs** and **I drink fruit juice**.

Use no article with meals and with **school**, **work**, **bed**, and **home**. Say **I go to bed**.

Jobs need **a** or **an**. Say **She is a doctor**, not **She is doctor**.
examples: *Can you open **the** window, please?* (we know which window)
* **The** sun is very hot today.* (there is only one)
